result.description: A DELISH AFFAIR CATERING SERVICES PTY LTD  We are currently seeking a full-time chef to work within our client site at  Gladesville, NSW (2111) . This is a sensational role for someone who has great skills and is a go-getter.  The role would be working in coordination with our Director as well as the client on site, and will require you to have outstanding communication skills and excellent management abilities. If this sounds like you, please read on…    Benefits   Competitive Salary: AUD 83,000 + Super  Great Work-life balance    Task & responsibilities   BASIC FUNCTIONS    Responsible for liaising with the Client as the first point of contact on site, representing A Delish Affair Catering Services Pty Limited.   Planning and organizing of all six meals on a daily basis in close coordination with the Client as well as Director of the business.   Menu planning, Procurement and ordering of Stock and Equipment within the specified guidelines.   Maintain & Monitor quality and food standard parameters.  Effective management of modified and specific dietary needs of the client's patients.  Ensuring that all incumbents are coached and strictly adhere to the HACCP and WH&S standards at all times.   Liaising with the Clients for their onsite as well as offsite functions, managing end to end procedures whilst ensuring total client satisfaction.            ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS    Actively participating in the Annual Budget forecast by working in close coordination with the Director.  Reporting on the Site performance against the agreed budget on a monthly basis.   Working with the Client to establish dietary requirements for each patient and ensuring that these are well documented and adhered to at all meal times  Introducing new dishes and demonstrating the cooking techniques to all staff, ensuring that the processes are well documented for all to follow at all times.   Supervising other staff while cooking the meals on a daily basis.   Responsible for maintaining, upholding and executing the site Online HACCP program whilst ensuring that all Food Safety records are maintained as per legislative and other requirements.   Selecting, hiring, training and disciplining staff at the allocated site of responsibility.   Responsible for ensuring that Monthly Stocktakes are completed appropriately, reporting on any anomalies observed, with an explanation of any shrinkage in both perpetual and non-perpetual stock items.   Coaching and Enforcing of all Food Safety guidelines while taking a lead on any new updates ensuring that A Delish Affair continues to be recognised for its outstanding work when it comes to health & safety of all parties involved and maintains its leadership position within the Catering Industry.   Maintaining rosters and timesheets for all team members and agency staff, and reporting to the Director on a weekly basis about staff absences and leave forecast.  Ensuring that all accidents and near misses are reported to the Client and Director, as well as documented to ensure safety and well-being of all.   Responsible for the overall operation, financial performance and WH&S on site.     Qualification & experience   Appropriate Qualification and at least 5 year of relevant work experience.  Demonstrated problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate at all levels.   Food Safety Supervisor Certification is a must.   Management of Institutional Catering experience – Highly regarded.  Police Clearance and Working with Children Check for the respective states.    About Company     We at ‘A Delish Affair Catering Services Pty Ltd’ are a team of highly experienced Catering Professionals with a demonstrated history of working in the hospitality industry. We specialize mainly in Hospitals and Institutional catering. We are proudly Australian-owned and operated, and our passion is all about good and fresh food. We take pride in our highly skilled team, as they cover all aspects of catering, on-job coaching, rostering, communication and site-specific cooking. We understand no two sites are the same, so, we develop a Site-specific catering delivery model. We provide more seasonal and customised menus, that provide the best overall value in service and quality. We believe that our quality of food and service provides our customers a ‘Delish’ experience. Our unique size and personalized services give us the edge over our competitors. Level 2 IT Administrator | Permanent Position | FIFO Option    Your new company     
 Join a large-scale, high-profile infrastructure project based in Cooma, supporting critical operations within a complex and dynamic IT environment. 
   
 This organisation brings together enterprise platforms, site-based infrastructure, and global support teams, offering a unique opportunity to work across a broad technology stack. 
   
 For candidates based outside the region, FIFO arrangements and accommodation support can be considered. 
   Your new role     
 As a Level 2 IT Administrator, you will act as a hybrid on-site IT generalist, primarily based in Cooma, with travel required every alternate week. You will deliver a mix of end-user support, infrastructure support, and application administration. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 Deliver Level 2 end-user and service desk support across hardware, software, and systems 
 Provide Level 1 support for key business applications such as Aconex, Primavera P6, Revit, Revizto, and SAP ECTR 
 Support infrastructure including networks, endpoints, and site connectivity (Level 2) 
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and SAP environments 
 Coordinate with internal IT, DSI support teams, and third-party vendors to resolve incidents 
 Maintain documentation for systems, configurations, and support activities 
 Ensure IT systems meet security and compliance standards 
 Manage IT assets including hardware/software inventory and lifecycle 
 Support application administration including user access, configuration, and maintenance 
 
   
  Workload split:  
 
 End-user support: 50% 
 Infrastructure support: 30% 
 Application support: 10% 
 Asset management and administration: 10% 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Proven experience in a Level 2 IT support or systems administration role 
 Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and systems 
 Experience with Microsoft 365, Windows, Azure, Citrix, and general infrastructure 
 Ability to manage competing priorities in a hands-on, site-based environment 
 Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with multiple support teams 
 
   
  Desirable experience:  
 
 SharePoint 
 Primavera P6 Professional 
 Aconex 
 Autodesk Revit / Revizto 
 SAP ECTR 
 LMS or specialist project management tools 
 
 
 Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based environments will be highly regarded. 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Salary package of $160,000 - $180,000 + super 
 Accommodation support where required 
 FIFO options available for non-local candidates 
 Opportunity to work on a major infrastructure project 
 Exposure to a broad and technically diverse environment 
 A hands-on role with strong ownership and autonomy 
 
  What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to  charlie.pym@hays.com.au .    If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description: SBDC testing pty Ltd   Employment Type:  Full-time (38 hours per week) role as a Contract Administrator  SBDC Testing is seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to support the commercial and administrative functions of our growing concrete testing operations. This role is responsible for managing contracts and variations, liaising with project stakeholders, overseeing contractor work, and ensuring compliance across our testing engagements with builders, suppliers and engineers.  As our project workload and client base continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Contract Administrator to manage the contractual and administrative side of our testing services. This is a full-time, office-based role supporting our operations across New South Wales, working closely with our technical and operations teams to ensure every engagement is properly documented, compliant, and delivered to the standard our clients expect.      Benefits   Competitive salary commensurate with experience  Ongoing professional development and training opportunities  Supportive and collaborative team environment  Career progression opportunities within a growing business  Standard full-time hours with a stable, permanent position    Task & responsibilities   Developing, reviewing and negotiating variations to contracts, programs, projects and services  Responding to inquiries and resolving problems concerning contracts, programs, projects, services provided, and persons affected  Managing paperwork associated with contracts, programs, projects and services provided  Working with project managers, builders, engineers and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met  Advising senior management on matters requiring attention and assisting in implementing decisions  Overseeing work undertaken by contractors and reporting on variations to work orders  Preparing and reviewing submissions and reports concerning the organisation's activities  Collecting and analysing data associated with projects undertaken, and reporting on project outcomes    Qualification & experience   Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in contract administration, construction administration, or a similar role  Tertiary qualification in business, commerce, construction management, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience)  Strong organisational and communication skills  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)  Ability to liaise effectively with contractors, project stakeholders, and senior management  Sound understanding of contract documentation and compliance requirements   About Company     SBDC Testing is a trusted provider of concrete testing services, established in 2014 and operating across Australia. With a strong focus on accuracy, reliability, and integrity, SBDC has built a reputation for delivering high-quality testing solutions that support the successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects.    Our team works closely with builders, concrete suppliers, and engineers to ensure every aspect of testing is carried out in strict accordance with Australian Standards, providing confidence that all materials meet required specifications.    At SBDC Testing, we pride ourselves on being responsive, professional, and solutions focused. Our commitment is simple: accurate, timely and dependable testing that helps clients minimise risk, maintain compliance, and deliver projects with confidence.
